sentences.text: Researchers conducted a prospective cohort study following 4,822 people who met specific inclusion criteria over several years.

Scientists measured walking ability and balance using the Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA), a tool for evaluating mobility, while tracking that 251 participants were later diagnosed with dementia and 458 died during the period.
The authors note that the study results may not apply to other groups because all participants shared the same ethnic background.
